description: Returns the covers of Vogue Paris issues as images, with each issue's date and reader link, up to 12 at a time. Covers are returned for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain); a later year returns its issue list and links only. Examples: {"year": 1925}; {"from": "1927-01-01", "to": "1927-06-30"}; {"issues": ["1920-06-15", "1926-03"]}.

issues.description: Specific issues instead of a year or range

items.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")

name: look_at_covers
title: Look at covers
